## Why it matters

VASE aggregates historical and contemporary visual materials from Southeastern Europe, including photographs, postcards, posters, and map-based discovery tools.

Its themed collections on migration, family and gender, urban life, cinema, and regional postcard cultures support comparative visual and cultural history research.
